title: QA Test Plan — AIG Japan Auto
description: Official AIG QA test plan for the Japan Auto SDLC lifecycle. Produced by the QA stage (S7: QA_TESTING). Grounded in accepted DevDocument (required), StoriesDocument (Gherkin AC), SRDDocument (workflows + integrations), FSDDocument (screen specs), and BRDDocument (business rules). 10 sections — each section traces to a prior artifact or KB card; no section is fabricated.

source_hierarchy.story_test_cases: StoriesDocument.stories Gherkin AC (ac_given / ac_when / ac_then) — NO KB fallback; QA-BLOCKED stub when Gherkin is empty
source_hierarchy.screen_validations: FSDDocument.screen_specs (ScreenSpec.fields + ScreenSpec.business_rules) — NO KB fallback; FSD-STUB when empty
source_hierarchy.business_rule_tests: BRDDocument.business_rules primary → brd.references BR-* card_bodies fallback; KB-GAP stub when both empty
source_hierarchy.workflow_scenarios: SRDDocument.sequence_diagrams (Mermaid DSL parsed for participants + messages) — NO KB fallback; ARCH-STUB when empty
source_hierarchy.role_access_tests: stories.as_a × dev.impl_tasks.screens_to_update cross-reference — NO KB fallback; NO-ROLE stub when as_a empty
source_hierarchy.integration_tests: SRDDocument.integration_design primary → srd.references INT-*/API-* card_bodies fallback; ARCH-STUB when both empty
source_hierarchy.regression_scope: Derived deterministically from story_test_cases + screen_validations + business_rule_tests (capped at 20)
source_hierarchy.gap_log: Deterministic stubs from all sections + LLM-identified supplemental gaps (max 5, deduped)
source_hierarchy.references: All prior artifact refs + KB card IDs used (from allowed_ids)

stub_markers.QA-BLOCKED: Gherkin AC is empty — Stories stage must re-run to populate Given/When/Then
stub_markers.FSD-STUB: FSD screen spec is empty — FSD stage must re-run to populate fields and business rules
stub_markers.KB-GAP: No rule text in BRD and no KB card found — add BR-* card via /kb-build then re-generate
stub_markers.ARCH-STUB: No Mermaid DSL or protocol in SRD — Architecture stage must re-run
stub_markers.NO-ROLE: Story has no as_a actor — Stories stage must re-run to set persona

sections.title: 1. Test Scope
sections.description: LLM-generated test scope narrative (≤300 words). Summarises what is in scope, what prior artifacts were used, and what stubs remain. Fallback (no model): deterministic summary of source counts + populated/gapped sections.

sections.title: 2. Story Test Cases
sections.description: One or more TestCase entries per user story. Derived from Gherkin AC (ac_given → preconditions, ac_when → steps, ac_then → expected_result). QA-BLOCKED stub emitted when Gherkin is empty — fix Stories, not QA.

sections.title: 3. Screen Validations
sections.description: One ScreenValidation per FSD ScreenSpec. field_validations from ScreenSpec.fields; rule_validations from ScreenSpec.business_rules. FSD-STUB emitted when ScreenSpec is empty — fix FSD, not QA.

sections.title: 4. Business Rule Tests
sections.description: One BusinessRuleTest per BRD business rule (primary) or KB BR-* card (fallback via brd.references). test_assertions derived from rule_text. KB-GAP stub emitted when both sources are empty — add KB card via /kb-build.

sections.title: 5. Workflow Scenarios
sections.description: One WorkflowScenario per SRD sequence diagram. Participants and scenario_steps extracted from Mermaid DSL via message regex. ARCH-STUB emitted when DSL is empty — fix Architecture stage.

sections.title: 6. Role Access Tests
sections.description: One RoleAccessTest per as_a actor × screens_to_update cross-reference (stories × dev impl_tasks). test_assertions cover allowed/denied access patterns. NO-ROLE stub emitted when as_a is empty.

sections.title: 7. Integration Tests
sections.description: One IntegrationTest per SRD integration point (primary) or KB INT-*/API-* card (fallback via srd.references). test_assertions from _PROTOCOL_ASSERTIONS for the detected protocol. ARCH-STUB when both empty.

sections.title: 8. Regression Scope
sections.description: Deterministic regression scope: one item per story, screen, and business rule (capped at 20). LLM may append up to 5 additional items; cap holds.

sections.title: 9. Gap Log
sections.description: All QAGap entries collected during test plan assembly. gap_type: no_gherkin | empty_fsd_scr | empty_brd_rules | no_role | empty_srd_seq | empty_srd_int | kb_gap. Each gap carries an action — fix the upstream stage or add KB content before re-generating.

sections.title: 10. References
sections.description: Prior artifact refs (dev_ref, stories_ref, srd_ref, fsd_ref, brd_ref) and all KB card IDs used in this test plan.

sections.title: 11. Test Execution Records
sections.description: Append-only test execution log. Updated via POST /ws/{id}/qa/execute. status: TODO | PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | SKIP. FAIL/BLOCKED block acceptance unless override_justification is provided.

gate.description: QA test plan accepted — all FAIL/BLOCKED executions resolved or overridden — before workspace advances to PENDING_SYNC
